actions.restartChatGptConfirmDescription: This closes and relaunches local ChatGPT/Codex. Use it after first enabling the proxy or switching while the proxy is off.

settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.description: Choose the interface language. This setting is saved locally.
settings.language.label: Interface language
settings.theme.title: Theme color
settings.theme.description: Customize the accent color used across navigation, buttons, selected rows, and controls.
settings.theme.label: Accent color
settings.navigationStyle.title: Navigation style
settings.navigationStyle.description: Keep navigation at the top or move it to a collapsible sidebar. This setting is saved locally.
settings.navigationStyle.label: Navigation layout
settings.launchAtStartup.title: Launch at startup
settings.launchAtStartup.description: Start Remote AI automatically after you sign in to your computer.
settings.launchAtStartup.label: Start automatically
settings.autoUpdate.title: Automatic updates
settings.autoUpdate.description: On by default: install downloaded updates on the next launch.
settings.autoUpdate.label: Install updates automatically
settings.autoUpdate.saveError: Could not save update installation settings. Please try again.
settings.closeToTray.title: Close window behavior
settings.chatGptEnhancements.title: ChatGPT enhancements
settings.chatGptEnhancements.label: Enable enhancements
settings.chatGptEnhancements.description: Applies outside proxy mode. When off, switching accounts still restarts ChatGPT, but only updates sign-in details and does not use skins.
settings.chatGptEnhancements.nextLaunch: The launch mode changes the next time ChatGPT starts or you switch accounts.
settings.chatGptEnhancements.loadError: Could not load this setting. Reopen Settings and try again.
settings.chatGptEnhancements.saveError: Could not save this setting. Please try again.
settings.chatGptEnhancements.skinDisable: Turn on ChatGPT enhancements in Settings to use skins.
settings.closeToTray.description: Keep Remote AI running in the system tray when you close the main window.
settings.closeToTray.label: Minimize to tray
settings.sections.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.sections.appearance.description: Language, color, layout, and floating usage display.
settings.sections.system.title: System & updates
settings.sections.system.description: Manage startup, window closing, and automatic updates.
settings.sections.usage.title: Usage & automation
settings.sections.usage.description: Control refresh schedules, usage summaries, and automatic account handling.
settings.sections.connection.title: Network & sync
settings.sections.connection.description: Manage local web access, network proxies, and cloud connections.
settings.sections.privacy.title: Privacy & security
settings.sections.privacy.description: Protect account details and manage secure cross-device features.
settings.sections.storage.title: Storage & diagnostics
settings.sections.storage.description: Open local data folders and export troubleshooting information.
settings.privacy.title: Privacy mode
settings.privacy.description: Choose whether account details and notes are hidden in the account list. Account details are hidden by default; notes remain visible.
settings.accountDisplay.title: Account display mode
settings.accountDisplay.description: Choose how official accounts and third-party providers are shown. This setting is saved locally.
settings.accountDisplay.label: Display mode
settings.tokenUsage.title: Token usage heatmap
settings.tokenUsage.description: Set the visible range and refresh interval for Token statistics.
settings.codexUsageSummary.title: Codex daily usage
settings.codexUsageSummary.description: Show today's Token usage, estimated cost, and available quota beside the Codex composer.
settings.sseIdleTimeout.title: Streaming response wait
settings.sseIdleTimeout.description: Applies to all proxied streaming responses. Turn off the limit to keep waiting during long reasoning pauses. Changes apply to new requests.
settings.proxyTransport.title: Connection retries and redirects
settings.proxyTransport.description: Retry connection timeouts every 2 seconds before sending the request. Retries exclude the first attempt. Set either count to 0 to disable it.
settings.responseHeaderTimeout.title: Initial response wait
settings.responseHeaderTimeout.descripti: How long to wait for the service to start responding after sending a request. Defaults to 10 minutes. Changes apply to new requests.
settings.upstream429Retry.title: Upstream rate-limit retries
settings.upstream429Retry.description: For HTTP 429 responses, retry after 1, 3, 5 seconds and continue with increasing waits. The default limit is one minute. When it expires, eligible accounts are automatically excluded before the error is returned.
settings.upstream429Retry.label: Maximum retry time
settings.usageNetworkErrors.title: Usage network error alerts
settings.usageNetworkErrors.description: Show account errors caused by timeouts or connection failures. HTTP status errors are always shown and keep their existing handling.
settings.usageNetworkErrors.label: Show network errors
settings.autoDisableStatusCodes.title: Automatic-disable HTTP statuses
settings.autoDisableStatusCodes.descript: Select the HTTP statuses that can exclude an account when automatic disabling is enabled. The list includes a short explanation for each standard status; 401, 402, 403, and 429 are selected by default.
settings.autoDisableStatusCodes.label: HTTP statuses
settings.webProxy.title: Web version listening port
settings.webProxy.description: Enter a port to start the web version. LAN requests require the web access key shown below.
settings.webProxy.scopeLan: LAN devices with the access key
hostedWebApiKey.title: Enter LAN access key
hostedWebApiKey.description: Enter the LAN access key shown in Remote AI to continue.
settings.networkProxy.title: Network proxy
settings.networkProxy.description: Use an HTTP(S) or SOCKS proxy for Remote AI. When off, use your computer’s network settings.
settings.networkProxy.invalidAddress: Enter an HTTP(S) or SOCKS proxy address without a port or path.
settings.networkProxy.invalidPort: Enter a proxy port between 1 and 65535.
settings.cloud.title: Cloud sync server
settings.cloud.description: Configure the server used by Remote AI login. Leaving it empty keeps cloud login disabled.
settings.cloud.label: Base URL
settings.cloud.signedIn: Cloud login is enabled and this device is signed in.
settings.cloud.enabled: Cloud login is enabled. Use the login button in the top bar.
settings.cloud.localMode: Cloud login is disabled. Accounts stay in local secure storage.
settings.autoRefresh.title: Global usage auto refresh
settings.autoRefresh.description: Refresh every saved account and every Provider with balance queries configured. Manual refresh still works when disabled.
settings.accountAutoRefresh.title: Current account / Provider auto refresh
settings.accountAutoRefresh.description: Refresh the current account or selected Provider on its own timer. In concurrent mode, the same interval refreshes every enabled account.
settings.accountAutoRefresh.none: No refreshable current account or Provider
settings.floatingBubble.title: Floating usage bubble
settings.floatingBubble.description: View 5-hour and weekly remaining quota for the current account or the average across all accounts. Drag the always-on-top bubble to reposition it.
